scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn vox_pm.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.check:py: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check src && uv run mypy src
scripts.check:ts: pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm --filter web lint
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:revision: cd apps/api && uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m
